content.text: - Anosmia: loss of smell       - Hyposmia: ↓sense of smell
- central pathways: damage to olfactory bulb
Vision: visual acuity, visual fields, fundoscopic exam
Sensory Regions:     V1: ophthalmic      V2: Maxillary
Motor: Somatic efferent to mastication musc
unilat masseter or temporal motor weakness
facial expressions, eye closure, mouth closure +
- facial weakness: nasolabial folds, lower lid droop
Sensory: P. 1/3 of tongue; pain, temp, touch -pharynx/middle ear/tonsils
Motor: stylopharyngeus musc, elev pharynx/larynx w swallowing/speech, gag reflex
Swallowing, speaking, breathing, Phonation, uvula, soft palate
Sensory: pharynx, larynx, external acoustic meatus
Motor: pharynx, soft palate, larynx -swallowing/voice prod (phonation), gag reflex
- palate fails to rise -> central lesion
- trapezius weakness/atrophy (MC as a peripheral n. issue)
tongue mvt, lingual sounds, strength, tremors
Tongue Toward side of weakness -> away from lesion
